title: AIriskEval-edu: New Dataset for Risk Assessment in AI-mediated K-12 Educational Explanations
reasoning: The paper introduces a dataset and benchmark for evaluating pedagogical risks (e.g., factual accuracy, instructional relevance, and ideological bias) in AI-generated K-12 educational explanations. While it evaluates 'ideological bias' (stereotypes, exclusionary framing), it does not specifically evaluate or benchmark religious concepts, moral reasoning, or formal ethical frameworks.
